text:
alex: Heads up — seeing kubelet crashloops on several gpu nodes in us-west-2a. Autoscaler keeps adding nodes, but newly provisioned nodes hit the same crash and immediately get evicted, causing a scaling thrash :rotating_light:
pranav: logs show repeated `kubelet: panic: runtime error` right after node bootstrap. Possibly a driver/kernel mismatch with the node image.
jordyn: Which nodepool? is this the low-priority-gpu pool or the reserved one?
azne: (reacted with :eyes:)
azne: tagging infra-bot to pull recent node events
infra-bot: ALERT: Node kubelet crashloop detected (count=7) in cluster prod-usw2. Affected nodepool: worker-gpu-spot-usw2a. Recent events: ImagePullBackOff (nvidia-driver), kubelet panic, node NotReady -> cordon triggered.
azne: ok that's the spot pool — looks like a new kernel update rolled into the image last deploy window.
alex: I'm going to cordon the remaining healthy nodes in that pool and scale down spot pool to 0 to stop churn. Can someone patch the launch template?
pranav: +1. Quick commands: 
```
# cordon all nodes in pool
kubectl get nodes -l pool=worker-gpu-spot-usw2a -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl cordon {}
# scale nodegroup to 0 (autoscaling group)
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name asg-worker-gpu-spot-usw2a --min-size 0 --desired-capacity 0
```
zane: I've opened an Infra CR to revert the AMI/kernel change and kicked off an image rebuild. Linking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2487
jordyn: Meanwhile can we failover critical inference traffic to dedicated-gpu-usw2b? We should flip routing for the affected model endpoints.
deploy-bot: rollout: route change initiated for endpoints with tag=prod-critical -> targeting dedicated-gpu-usw2b. Watch for 502/429s.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor SLOs, throttles. If latency spikes, enable fallback to smaller model to protect latency.
alex: Action list: 1) cordon + scale down spot pool (pranav) 2) revert AMI/kernel in launch template (zane) 3) route critical traffic to dedicated pool (jordyn/deploy-bot) 4) postmortem owner? assign to zane.
pranav: cordon + asg scale commands executed. Nodes no longer accepting new pods. Stopping autoscaler by setting cluster-autoscaler flag `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false` won't help here; manual ASG control needed.
azne: rollbacks in progress — new AMI build started. ETA ~25m.
infra-bot: NOTE: Node termination events suppressed to avoid alert spam.
ops-oncall: SLOs holding so far. A few retries for background jobs — no customer-facing errors yet.
alex: Thanks. After AMI rebuild and smoke tests we can slowly bring reserved nodes back. Postmortem when stable. :thumbsup:
